TOOL_PREFERENCES (permanent):
- str_replace: lineHint is mandatory on files >100 lines. Standard workflow: grep-file → read-lines → str_replace with lineHint.
- grep-file: do NOT use | alternations in regex — causes 'Unterminated group'. Use separate grep-file calls.
- session-notes: actions are read/write/clear only. To rewrite notes: clear then write individually.
- save-all instead of save-file (save-file needs tool_search each session). save-all silently skips unchanged files — normal.
- open-file before str_replace when editor focus may have shifted (wrong active editor is the cause of 'closest area found' errors).
- checkpatch filePath: always use full absolute path from list-open-files — relative paths resolve to Pulsar install dir, not project root.
- run-command: PowerShell uses ; not && as command separator.
- get-repo-map is MANDATORY second step after reading session notes at every session start. Call it before any grep/read/list to orient on project structure.
- save-all MUST come before node --check — node --check reads disk not buffer. get-diagnostics reads live buffer so is safe before save.

TOOL_QUIRKS (permanent):
- replace-block: low hit rate — only use on genuinely brace-delimited blocks, never bare if/for.
- delete-block: startContent/endContent anchors work well for multi-line dead-code removal.
- sed: bypasses ambiguity guard — use when str_replace is blocked. Always dryRun:true first. Unreliable on module.exports lines when nearby template literals contain partial matches.
- occurrence:N: first instinct for ambiguous patterns.
- apply-patch: LIFETIME 0 hits — avoid entirely. str_replace+lineHint is more reliable.
- replace-document: not wired to inline style check. checkpatch manually after large rewrites. USE for any edit touching a markdown table (pipes break str_replace matching).
- replace-function-body: ambiguous when function name appears 6+ times. Use afterHint or occurrence:N. Unreliable near TOOL_CATALOGUE export const in mcp-registration.js — use str_replace+lineHint in that zone.
- replace-across-files: glob must always be lib/*.js — NEVER **/*.js (hits .mcp-baseline/ backup). $1/$2 backreferences NOW WORK (fixed v0.10.27 via applyReplacement helper).
- str_replace on backtick-heavy or quote-heavy markdown lines fails — use insert with afterContent anchor instead.
- str_replace with template literal containing ${} in old_str TIMES OUT on mcp-registration.js — use delete-line-range + insert for any line containing template literal expressions.
- str_replace on large multi-line blocks in mcp-registration.js TIMES OUT — use delete-line-range + insert instead.
- After save of mcp-registration.js: hot-reload shifts active editor. Always open-file the next target after any mcp-registration save.
- emoji / Unicode in old_str: use fuzzyContent:true or regex:true. Lines with → arrows or box-drawing runs are str_replace-hostile — use delete-line-range + insert.
- apply-patch fuzzy rescue is unreliable when hunk context contains regex literals — use delete-line-range + insert directly.

MCREG_ARCHITECTURE (reference):
- styleStats / lifetimeStyleStats: per-rule { introduced: 0 } objects + _totalCHEdits, _totalViolations, _cleanEdits, _checkpatchRuns, _checkpatchViolations counters.
- Reset loop is self-maintaining: Object.keys(styleStats) — adding new rules to the stat objects is sufficient.
- bumpStyle(type, n): gates on styleStats[type] existing.
- applyStyleCheck(newStr, filePath): inline check, isWholeFile=false — only fires on .c/.h.
- buildStyleReport(): module-scope function.
- summarise() / buildReport(): module-scope functions. buildReport() uses st(key) = stats[key]||{} accessor.
- sumFails(obj): module-scope helper.
- maybeLintSuffix: always-on (gate removed v0.10.25). Delta pattern: pre/post snapshot diff, only surfaces new messages.
- isCodeFilePath(p): module-scope helper using CODE_FILE_RE.
- isGhidraFile(filePath, text): module-scope.
- fnRe: declared locally in each of 3 handlers (list-project-functions, list-functions, get-function-list-with-comments).
- BASELINE RULE: .mcp-baseline/ is read-only backup — NEVER edit it.
- anchorError(hintName, hintValue, result): module-scope helper.
- bump(): hyphen→underscore normalisation at top — 'close-file' resolves to close_file stats key.
- logFailure(): NDJSON append to failure-log.ndjson. failureLogPath in getEditStats() output.
- applyReplacement(rep, m, groups, pre, post): module-scope helper for $$, $1..$9, $&, $`, $' in replace-all, replace-across-files, sed.
- STRUCT_EXTENSIONS gate (not isKernelFile) for struct-check — covers .c .h .js .ts etc.
- buildEditResponse() wired to all 15 edit commit sites via lib/edit-response.js.
- PRE-REBOOT CHECKLIST (mandatory):
  1. node --check lib\mcp-registration.js → exit 0
  2. grep "^import \|^export " lib/*.js → zero matches
  3. get-diagnostics project → 0 errors 0 warnings

TREE_SITTER_ARCHITECTURE (reference):
- lib/tree-sitter-symbols.js: getSymbolsFromEditor(editor), getSymbolsFromText(text, filePath), getSymbols(editor, text, filePath), findFunction(symbols, name, hints), resolveAnchor(hint, symbols, text), braceEndRow(lines, fromRow). All exported.
- resolveAnchor resolution chain: (1) exact symbol name → sym.endRow [symbolEnd], (2) pure integer → lineNumber, (3) text.indexOf scan with uniqueness check [string].
- afterHint:"fn_name" resolves to END of that function (sym.endRow) — correct for insert-after, wrong for searching inside a function body. Use functionHint for that.
- betweenHint:{start:"fn_a", end:"fn_b"} spans from end of fn_a to end of fn_b.
- GHIDRA_FUNC_RE: intentionally NOT migrated to tree-sitter.
- MIGRATION STATUS: COMPLETE as of v0.10.21. Full tool audit passed v0.10.22.

KERNEL C STYLE RULES (LLM self-note):
- NO Doxygen headers (@file/@brief) — use plain /* */ block comment.
- NO single-line if bodies: "if (x) return y;" — body must be on next line.
- NO = NULL initialiser on file-scope statics (zero-init is implicit).
- Declarations before code (e.g. va_list ap before any if statements).
- Tabs not spaces for indentation.
- singleline_if is a CHECK rule in style-checker.js — inline checker will catch it.
STYLE-CHECKER RULES: trailing_whitespace(E), wrong_indentation(E), dos_line_endings(E), missing_newline_eof(E), trailing_blank_lines(E), line_too_long(W), keyword_spacing(W), space_before_open_brace(W), open_brace_control(W), open_brace_function(W), else_brace_placement(W), space_before_semicolon(W), paren_spacing(W), comma_spacing(W), operator_spacing(W), pointer_spacing(W), single_line_comment(C), consecutive_blanks(C), singleline_if(C).
NAMING-CHECKER: checkNaming (fn_no_verb, fn_camel_case, var_camel_case, macro_lowercase), checkFunctionDocs (missing_doc, wrong_doc_style, plainDoc — 3 tiers), buildDocSkeleton. All gated on isKernelFile(). check-function-docs includes signature + [in header] tag per entry. insert-function-doc accepts line: anchor from check-function-docs output.

LESSONS PERMANENT:
1. replace-across-files glob must be lib/*.js — NEVER **/*.js (hits .mcp-baseline/).
2. apply-patch fuzzy rescue fails on adjacent near-identical lines — use str_replace+lineHint+afterHint per site.
3. str_replace afterHint on a common string may match wrong site — drop afterHint and use lineHint only, or add fuzzyWhitespace:true.
4. Multi-internal-edits to one function: go straight to replace-function-body with lineHint — never chain str_replace inside a single function.
5. sed unreliable on module.exports lines near template literals. Always dryRun:true first.
6. node --check catches embedded */ inside block comments. Never write /* ... */ ... */ on one line.
7. replace-function-body near TOOL_CATALOGUE export const is unreliable — use str_replace+lineHint.
8. save-all before running Get-Content / grep in PowerShell — PowerShell reads disk not buffer.
9. str_replace fails on markdown table rows (pipes) — use replace-document.
10. lineHint ambiguity guard: when old_str matched N times in ±50 window, use occurrence:N shown in preview.
11. fuzzyContent = passive, for encoding variants of KNOWN chars (smart-quotes, BOM, NBSP, box-drawing runs → '--'). regex:true = active, for UNKNOWN/variable unicode (emoji, box-drawing, backticks, arrows).
12. str_replace with ${} template literal in old_str always times out on mcp-registration.js — use delete-line-range + insert.
13. ESLint espree chokes on lines >~800 chars with 'Unterminated string constant' even when node --check passes. Split long desc strings with + concat.
14. When adding a new top-level key to editStats: add defensive ||{} guards to ALL direct-access sites in getEditStats session block.
15. insert afterContent inserts AFTER the matched line. To insert before a line use insert_line:N directly.
16. After lineHintFallback replaces a return line preceded by const declarations, verify const declarations still appear BEFORE the return.
17. Two undos needed after an insert+partial state — undo reverts in reverse order.
CHAT PANEL NOTES (permanent):
- paste/drop events must be on this.element at capture phase (3rd arg true) + stopImmediatePropagation().
- Never add atom command for paste on element with native-key-bindings — loops.
- chat-panel.js and .less changes require Pulsar package reload — they do NOT hot-reload on save.
DOM/MODULE NOTES (permanent):
- await in activate() can delay past onDidActivateInitialPackages — always guard with hasActivatedInitialPackages() check first.
- this.X is never available inside express route handlers — use module-level vars.
